says: In next/, B1 budgets a crash call at 4 steps of 3 lifecycle reads (12), while a crash reads 4 at the head and 9 when every ended and living check reads fresh, so a crash call that went back to reading the lifecycle at every check stays inside its budget.
proof: On a scratch copy, Runner.ts's ended and living changed to read base.status every time and B1's assertion replaced by a print: crash printed '9 of 12' (4 runs), restart '14 of 12', inc '11 of 3'; at the head, crash printed '4 of 12'.
cost: A regression to per-check reads on the crash path is caught only because other moves in the same walk also regress; a change confined to recovery would pass B1.
